summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of AI Episode Studio MVP. 17/17 backend pytest cases passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering health, meta, /me, projects CRUD, rewrite, split-scenes (6 scenes), characters CRUD, scenes CRUD, generate-image, segment create/expand/approve/regenerate, cost-estimate (both endpoints), export, and all 5 admin endpoints. Frontend Playwright flow validated: Dashboard hero + create project dialog, navigation to /projects/:id, Story tab rewrite + split, Scenes tab generate-image / generate-video / expand-5s buttons present and functional (6 of each after split), Characters tab add character, Export tab approved timeline + final cut placeholder, Admin page with stats and all 4 tabs (users/projects/generations/failed). Mock 5% failure path handled with retry in tests; no failures encountered in this run.

minor.issue: Segments belonging to scenes of deleted project are NOT cleaned up (cascade missing). Comment in code acknowledges this. Will leave orphan segment docs in DB.
Implemented as direct call to create_segment; status 503 path will surface the same generic message. Acceptable for MVP.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription to create-project and add-character dialogs.

action_items: (Optional) Cascade-delete segments when a project is deleted (server.py delete_project).
(Optional) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to shadcn Dialog usages to clear React a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 617-line file; acceptable for MVP but could be split into routers/projects.py, routers/scenes.py, routers/admin.py if it grows.
All Mongo reads/writes correctly exclude `_id` via projection or use insert_one(doc.copy()) — good.
Random 5% failure path is well-isolated and logs to generations collection for admin visibility — works as designed.
No input validation on free-text fields beyond Pydantic types; acceptable for single-user demo.
test_credentials: None required (no auth — single-user demo, user-demo seeded on startup).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed projects/characters and delete the project at session teardown. One TEST UI Project remains from frontend run; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression baseline — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend hot-reload is on; REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is the only base URL used. Mock generators have intentional 5% 503 — tests already retry up to 3x.
